content:
The perimeter constraint is
\[
2r+r\theta=20 \quad\Rightarrow\quad r=\frac{20}{\theta+2}.
\]
The sector area is
\[
A=\frac12 r^2\theta=\frac12\left(\frac{20}{\theta+2}\right)^2\theta
=\frac{200\theta}{(\theta+2)^2}.
\]
Differentiate:
\[
A'=200\frac{2-\theta}{(\theta+2)^3}.
\]
Set \(A'=0\), giving
\[
\theta=2.
\]
Thus the area is maximized when the central angle is
\[
\boxed{2\text{ rad}}.
\]
